QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_29

question.text: During the Liquidation Period of a close-ended Cat III AIF, in-specie distribution of unliquidated investments requires approval of:

answer.text: At least 75% of investors by value

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Chapter 13.6.2 and Regulation 29-related 2024 amendment: during the Liquidation Period, in-specie distribution requires approval of AT LEAST 75% of investors BY VALUE of their investment. The AIF must also arrange bids for at least 25% of unliquidated-investment value. **The Trap:** Two-thirds (B) is fund-tenure-extension threshold (different). Simple majority (A) and unanimity (D) are wrong. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D test the same 75% rule. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Run the 25%-bid arrangement process with merchant-banker involvement; dissenting investors get priority exit from the 25% pool; unsubscribed portion is then pro-rated to non-dissenting investors.
